blocks.text: في الدرس السابق 60 تعلمنا كيفية نقل الجمل الخبرية من الكلام المباشر إلى الكلام المنقول. سنكمل الموضوع بنقل الأسئلة والأوامر والتعليمات والطلبات والنصائح والتحذيرات والاقتراحات.

items.direct: He said, "I am tired."
items.reported: He said that he was tired.

blocks.text: الفكرة الأهم: لا نحتفظ بترتيب السؤال المباشر؛ بل نحوله إلى ترتيب جملة خبرية، مع النظر إلى المتحدث والمخاطَب والسياق.

items.direct: Where do you live?
items.reported: He asked me where I lived.
items.note: اختفت do وجاء الفاعل قبل الفعل.

theory.title: أسئلة إجابتها نعم أو لا
theory.lead: إذا كانت الإجابة نعم أو لا، فابحث عن الرابط قبل بناء الجملة.

blocks.text: أسئلة Yes/No يمكن أن تكون إجابتها Yes = نعم أو No = لا. لا تبدأ بأداة سؤال مثل What أو Where أو Why، وإنما تبدأ غالبًا بفعل مساعد.
في نقل هذه الأسئلة نستخدم if = إذا / ما إذا، أو whether = ما إذا. الكلمتان متقاربتان في هذا التركيب.

blocks.en: Subject + asked + (object) + if / whether + subject + verb
blocks.ar: الفاعل + asked + الشخص الذي وُجّه إليه السؤال + if أو whether + الفاعل داخل السؤال + الفعل.

items.direct: He asked me, "Are you tired?"
items.reported: He asked me if I was tired.

items: أصبح ترتيب الكلمات I was، وليس was I.
تغيرت you إلى I لأن الشخص الذي يتحدث عنه السؤال هو أنا.
تغير فعل be من المضارع البسيط إلى الماضي البسيط عند تطبيق الرجوع الزمني الذي تعلمناه في الدرس 60.

blocks.ar: يتغير فعل be حسب الفاعل والزمن.

items.direct: She asked me, "Are you busy?"
items.reported: She asked me if I was busy.

items.direct: He asked her, "Is your brother at home?"
items.reported: He asked her if her brother was at home.
items.ar: سألها عما إذا كان أخوها في المنزل.

items.direct: The teacher asked us, "Are you ready?"
items.reported: The teacher asked us if we were ready.
items.ar: سألنا المعلم عما إذا كنا مستعدين.

items.direct: They asked him, "Were you ill yesterday?"
items.reported: They asked him whether he had been ill the previous day.
items.ar: سألوه عما إذا كان مريضًا في اليوم السابق.
items.note: السؤال الأصلي في الماضي؛ أصبح Past Perfect عند تطبيق الرجوع الزمني، وافترض النموذج تغير يوم النقل.

blocks.text: هذه نقطة مهمة: عندما يستخدم السؤال المباشر do أو does أو did في المضارع أو الماضي البسيط، تختفي هذه المساعدات في التحويل الأساسي لأن الجملة التابعة خبرية لا سؤال مباشر.

items.direct: She asked me, "Do you like coffee?"
items.reported: She asked me if I liked coffee.
items.ar: سألتني عما إذا كنت أحب القهوة.
items.note: Do حُذفت، وyou أصبحت I، وlike أصبحت liked.

items.direct: He asked me, "Does your father work here?"
items.reported: He asked me if my father worked there.
items.ar: سألني عما إذا كان أبي يعمل هناك.
items.note: Does حُذفت، وyour أصبحت my، وwork أصبحت worked، وhere أصبحت there لأن مكان الإشارة تغير في هذا المثال.

items.direct: The teacher asked Tom, "Did you finish the exercise?"
items.reported: The teacher asked Tom if he had finished the exercise.
items.ar: سأل المعلم توم عما إذا كان قد أنهى التمرين.
items.note: Did حُذفت، وfinish أصبحت had finished، وyou أصبحت he لأن المخاطَب Tom.

blocks.text: She asked me if I did like coffee ليست الصيغة الأساسية هنا؛ قد تستعمل did للتوكيد في سياقات خاصة. لا تنتقل Do / Does / Did عادةً بوصفها أفعالًا مساعدة مستقلة؛ نضبط الفعل الأساسي والزمن بحسب السياق.

items.direct: He asked me, "Have you finished your work?"
items.reported: He asked me if I had finished my work.
items.ar: سألني عما إذا كنت قد أنهيت عملي.

items.direct: She asked him, "Has your sister arrived?"
items.reported: She asked him if his sister had arrived.
items.ar: سألته عما إذا كانت أخته قد وصلت.

blocks.en: can → could  ·  will → would  ·  may → might

items.direct: He asked me, "Can you swim?"
items.reported: He asked me if I could swim.
items.ar: سألني عما إذا كنت أستطيع السباحة.

items.direct: She asked me, "Will you come tomorrow?"
items.reported: She asked me whether I would come the following day.
items.ar: سألتني عما إذا كنت سأحضر في اليوم التالي.

items.direct: The teacher asked us, "May I use your dictionary?"
items.reported: The teacher asked us whether he might use our dictionary.
items.alternative: The teacher asked us whether they might use our dictionary.
items.ar: سألنا المعلم عما إذا كان بإمكانه استخدام قاموسنا.
items.note: المصدر يستخدم he إذا كان المعلم رجلًا. لا يحدد السؤال الإنجليزي جنس المعلم؛ يمكن استخدام they للمفرد، أو she إذا عُرف أن المعلمة امرأة. المقصود هنا طلب الإذن، لا مجرد اختبار القدرة.

blocks.text: اختيار الضمير يعتمد على من قال الجملة ومن كان المخاطَب. تتغير كلمات الزمان والمكان والإشارة عندما يتغير مرجعها، لا تلقائيًا في كل موقف. والرجوع الزمني شائع في هذا النموذج، لكنه ليس إلزاميًا في كل سياق.
كلتاهما تصلحان في معظم أسئلة Yes/No المنقولة، ومعناهما متقارب في هذا التركيب.

items.en: He asked me if I was ready.
He asked me whether I was ready.

items.direct: He asked me, "Are you coming or not?"
items.reported: He asked me whether I was coming or not.
items.alternative: He asked me whether or not I was coming.
items.ar: سألني عما إذا كنت قادمًا أم لا.

blocks.text: يفضّل whether في هذا المثال مع or not؛ ويمكن أيضًا استعمال if عندما تأتي or not في نهاية الجملة. أما whether or not المتجاورة فلا نستبدل فيها whether بـ if.
أسئلة WH تبدأ بأداة استفهام. نحتفظ بالأداة نفسها عندما ننقل السؤال، ولا نضيف if أو whether إليها.

items.ar: كم للمفرد غير المعدود أو للسعر

blocks.ar: الفاعل + asked + الشخص + أداة السؤال + الفاعل + الفعل.

items.direct: He asked me, "Where do you live?"
items.reported: He asked me where I lived.

items.direct: She asked me, "Where are you going?"
items.reported: She asked me where I was going.

items.direct: He asked me, "When will you arrive?"
items.reported: He asked me when I would arrive.

items.direct: The teacher asked him, "Why did you leave early?"
items.reported: The teacher asked him why he had left early.
items.note: اختفت did وأصبحت left هي had left.

items.direct: She asked me, "What are you doing?"
items.reported: She asked me what I was doing.

items.direct: He asked me, "Which book do you prefer?"
items.reported: He asked me which book I preferred.

items.direct: The woman asked him, "Whose bag is this?"
items.reported: The woman asked him whose bag that was.
items.note: في هذا السياق أصبحت this هي that، والترتيب whose bag that was.

items.direct: He asked me, "How do you make this cake?"
items.reported: He asked me how I made that cake.

items.direct: She asked him, "How often do you exercise?"
items.reported: She asked him how often he exercised.

items.direct: He asked me, "How long have you lived here?"
items.reported: He asked me how long I had lived there.

items.direct: She asked me, "How much does this shirt cost?"
items.reported: She asked me how much that shirt cost.
items.ar: سألتني كم يبلغ سعر ذلك القميص.

items.direct: The teacher asked us, "How many books have you read?"
items.reported: The teacher asked us how many books we had read.

theory.title: عندما تكون أداة السؤال هي الفاعل

blocks.text: هذه حالة مهمة: في معظم الأسئلة نحتاج إلى إعادة ترتيب الكلمات، لكن أحيانًا تكون Who أو What هي الفاعل نفسه؛ لا نضيف فاعلًا آخر بعدها بلا سبب.

items.direct: He asked, "Who broke the window?"
items.reported: He asked who had broken the window.
items.note: Who هي من قام بفعل الكسر؛ لا نقول He asked who he had broken the window?

items.direct: She asked, "What happened?"
items.reported: She asked what had happened.

items.direct: The teacher asked, "Who knows the answer?"
items.reported: The teacher asked who knew the answer.

blocks.text: إذا كانت أداة WH هي الفاعل، احتفظ بها فاعلًا، ولا تضف فاعلًا آخر بلا سبب.
الأمر جملة يطلب فيها شخص من شخص آخر أن يفعل شيئًا.

blocks.ar: told + الشخص + to + الفعل في صورته الأساسية.

blocks.en: Subject + told + object + to + base verb

items.direct: The teacher said to us, "Open your books."
items.reported: The teacher told us to open our books.
items.note: Open أصبحت to open؛ استخدمنا told us لأن المعلم وجّه الأمر إلينا.

items.direct: My mother said to me, "Clean your room."
items.reported: My mother told me to clean my room.
items.ar: طلبت مني أمي أن أنظف غرفتي.

items.direct: The coach said to the players, "Run faster."
items.reported: The coach told the players to run faster.
items.ar: طلب المدرب من اللاعبين أن يركضوا بسرعة أكبر.

items.direct: The manager said to the workers, "Finish the project today."
items.reported: The manager told the workers to finish the project that day.
items.ar: طلب المدير من العمال إنهاء المشروع في ذلك اليوم.

blocks.text: عندما يكون الأمر حازمًا أو رسميًا يمكن استخدام ordered. وعندما يقدّم شخص إرشادات لتنفيذ عمل نستخدم instructed. يختلف الفعل بحسب نية المتحدث، لا بحسب الشكل وحده.

items.direct: The officer said to the soldiers, "Move immediately!"
items.reported: The officer ordered the soldiers to move immediately.

items.direct: The judge said to the man, "Leave the room."
items.reported: The judge ordered the man to leave the room.

items.direct: The doctor said to the patient, "Take this medicine twice a day."
items.reported: The doctor instructed the patient to take that medicine twice a day.
items.ar: وجّه الطبيب المريض إلى تناول ذلك الدواء مرتين يوميًا.

items.direct: The teacher said to the students, "Write your names at the top of the page."
items.reported: The teacher instructed the students to write their names at the top of the page.
items.ar: أرشد المعلم الطلاب إلى كتابة أسمائهم أعلى الصفحة.

blocks.en: Subject + told + object + not to + base verb

items.direct: He said to me, "Don't touch that wire."
items.reported: He told me not to touch that wire.
items.ar: طلب مني ألا ألمس ذلك السلك.

items.direct: The teacher said, "Don't make noise."
items.reported: The teacher told us not to make noise.
items.ar: طلب منا المعلم ألا نحدث ضوضاء.
items.note: يفترض المثال أننا المخاطَبون؛ يحدّد السياق الشخص المقصود.

items.direct: My father said to me, "Don't stay up late."
items.reported: My father told me not to stay up late.
items.ar: طلب مني أبي ألا أسهر حتى وقت متأخر.

items.direct: The police officer said to the driver, "Don't park here."
items.reported: The police officer told the driver not to park there.
items.ar: طلب الشرطي من السائق ألا يوقف السيارة هناك.

blocks.text: عندما يكون الكلام تحذيرًا من خطر نستخدم warned؛ وعندما يقدم شخص نصيحة لشخص آخر نستخدم advised.

blocks.en: warned + object + not to + infinitive  /  advised + object + to + infinitive

items.direct: The teacher said to the children, "Don't play near the road."
items.reported: The teacher warned the children not to play near the road.
items.ar: حذّر المعلم الأطفال من اللعب بالقرب من الطريق.

items.direct: The guide said to us, "Don't go near the edge."
items.reported: The guide warned us not to go near the edge.
items.ar: حذّرنا المرشد من الاقتراب من الحافة.

items.direct: My doctor said to me, "Exercise regularly."
items.reported: My doctor advised me to exercise regularly.

items.direct: My teacher said to me, "Study harder."
items.reported: My teacher advised me to study harder.
items.ar: نصحني معلمي بأن أدرس بجدية أكبر.

items.en: The guide warned us about the danger.
items.ar: حذّرنا المرشد من الخطر. ويمكن استعمال warned + object + about + noun.

items.en: My doctor advised me not to eat too much sugar.
items.ar: نصحني طبيبي بألا أتناول الكثير من السكر. وعند النهي عن شيء في النصيحة نستخدم advised + object + not to + infinitive.

theory.title: هل يسأل عن القدرة أم يطلب فعلًا؟

blocks.text: الأمر عادةً مباشر وحازم: Close the window. = أغلق النافذة. أما الطلب فأكثر تهذيبًا وغالبًا يستخدم Could you...? أو Can you...? أو Would you...? أو Will you...? أو Please....

items.direct: He said to me, "Could you help me?"
items.reported: He asked me to help him.
items.alternative: He asked me if I could help him.
items.note: الأولى تنقل طلب المساعدة؛ الثانية تنقل السؤال عن القدرة أو إمكانية المساعدة. السياق يحدد المقصود، ولا تكون الثانية خطأ لمجرد اختلاف القصد.

blocks.ar: عندما يكون المقصود طلب تنفيذ الفعل.

items.direct: She said to me, "Can you open the door, please?"
items.reported: She asked me to open the door.

items.direct: The teacher said to Tom, "Could you answer this question?"
items.reported: The teacher asked Tom to answer that question.
items.ar: طلب المعلم من توم أن يجيب عن ذلك السؤال.

items.direct: My friend said to me, "Would you wait for me?"
items.reported: My friend asked me to wait for him.

items.direct: She said to him, "Please carry this bag."
items.reported: She asked him to carry that bag.
items.ar: طلبت منه أن يحمل تلك الحقيبة.

items.direct: He said to me, "Please don't tell anyone."
items.reported: He asked me not to tell anyone.

items.direct: She said to us, "Please don't be late."
items.reported: She asked us not to be late.

blocks.text: الاقتراح فكرة، وليس أمرًا مباشرًا أو طلبًا من شخص أن ينفذ شيئًا بمفرده بالضرورة.

blocks.en: suggested + verb-ing  /  suggested that + subject + (should) + base verb

items.direct: He said, "Let's go to the park."
items.reported: He suggested going to the park.
items.alternative: He suggested that we should go to the park.
items.ar: اقترح الذهاب إلى الحديقة. / اقترح أن نذهب إلى الحديقة.

items.direct: She said, "Let's study together."
items.reported: She suggested studying together.
items.alternative: She suggested that we should study together.

items.label: NOT STANDARD
items.ar: صيغة غير صحيحة في الإنجليزية القياسية.

items.label: SUGGEST
items.en: She suggested studying. / She suggested that I should study.

blocks.text: بعد suggested that يمكن استخدام should + الفعل الأساسي أو الفعل الأساسي من دون should؛ أما suggested someone to فليست الصيغة القياسية.
Say تنقل الكلام أو المعلومة، وtell تذكر غالبًا الشخص المتلقي، وask تنقل الأسئلة والطلبات.

blocks.en: say + (that) + sentence  /  say + something + to + someone
blocks.ar: عند ذكر الشخص الذي وُجّه إليه الكلام مع say، نستخدم عادةً to قبل هذا الشخص.

items.en: He said that he was tired.
He said to me that he was tired.

blocks.en: tell + someone + to + verb  /  tell + someone + not to + verb
blocks.ar: في الأوامر نستخدم to، وفي النواهي نستخدم not to.

items.en: He told me that he was tired.
He told me not to wait.

blocks.text: لا نقول عادةً He told that he was tired لأن tell تحتاج غالبًا إلى الشخص المتلقي؛ الصحيح He told me that he was tired.

blocks.en: ask + if / whether + sentence  /  ask + WH-word + sentence  /  ask + someone + to + verb
blocks.ar: في أسئلة Yes/No نستخدم if أو whether، وفي أسئلة WH نحتفظ بأداة السؤال، وفي الطلبات نستخدم to.

items.en: She asked if I was ready.

items.label: SAY
items.en: He said that he was busy.

items.label: TELL
items.en: He told me that he was busy.

items.label: ASK · QUESTION
items.en: He asked if I was busy.

items.label: TELL · COMMAND
items.ar: أمرني أو طلب مني أن أنتظر.

errors.title: ترتيب السؤال المباشر
errors.wrong: He asked me where did I live.
errors.right: He asked me where I lived.
errors.why: بعد أداة السؤال نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية: subject + verb.

errors.title: if مع WH
errors.wrong: She asked me if where I lived.
errors.right: She asked me where I lived.
errors.why: Where هي أداة السؤال نفسها، فلا نحتاج إلى if.

errors.title: الإبقاء على did
errors.wrong: He asked me if did I like music.
errors.right: He asked me if I liked music.
errors.why: نحذف did المساعدة ونضع الفاعل قبل الفعل مع الرجوع الزمني المناسب.

errors.title: القلب بعد if
errors.wrong: She asked if was I tired.
errors.right: She asked if I was tired.
errors.why: بعد if نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية I was بدل was I.

errors.title: النهي بعد tell
errors.right: He told me not to go.
errors.why: النهي المنقول يستخدم told + object + not to + base verb.

errors.title: suggest مع شخص وto
errors.alternative: She suggested that I should study.
errors.why: استخدم suggested + ing أو suggested that؛ لا تستخدم suggested someone to.

errors.title: علامة الاستفهام
errors.wrong: He asked me, "Where do you live?"
errors.right: He asked me where I lived.
errors.why: الجملة المنقولة هنا خبرية كاملة فتنتهي بنقطة؛ أما إذا كانت الجملة الرئيسية سؤالًا حقيقيًا فقد تنتهي بعلامة استفهام.

procedures.title: سؤال Yes/No
procedures.direct: She asked me, "Do you speak English?"
steps: نحدد نوع السؤال: يبدأ بـ Do، إذن هو Yes/No.
نغير الزمن عند الحاجة: speak → spoke.
procedures.result: She asked me if I spoke English.
procedures.ar: سألتني عما إذا كنت أتحدث الإنجليزية.

procedures.title: سؤال WH
procedures.direct: He asked me, "Where are you going?"
procedures.result: He asked me where I was going.

procedures.title: أمر
procedures.direct: The teacher said to us, "Be quiet."
steps: نذكر الشخص الذي تلقى الأمر: us.
procedures.result: The teacher told us to be quiet.
procedures.ar: طلب منا المعلم أن نلتزم الهدوء.

procedures.title: نهي
procedures.direct: My father said to me, "Don't waste your time."
procedures.result: My father told me not to waste my time.
procedures.ar: طلب مني أبي ألا أضيع وقتي.

solved.direct: She asked him, "Are you learning English?"
solved.reported: She asked him if he was learning English.
solved.ar: سألته عما إذا كان يتعلم الإنجليزية.

solved.direct: The teacher asked me, "Why are you laughing?"
solved.reported: The teacher asked me why I was laughing.

solved.direct: He asked her, "Did you see my brother?"
solved.reported: He asked her if she had seen his brother.
solved.ar: سألها عما إذا كانت قد رأت أخاه.

solved.direct: The mother said to the children, "Wash your hands."
solved.reported: The mother told the children to wash their hands.
solved.ar: طلبت الأم من الأطفال أن يغسلوا أيديهم.

solved.direct: The guard said to us, "Don't enter this room."
solved.reported: The guard warned us not to enter that room.
solved.ar: حذّرنا الحارس من دخول تلك الغرفة.

solved.direct: He said to me, "Could you lend me your pen?"
solved.reported: He asked me to lend him my pen.

solved.direct: The doctor said to her, "You should get more sleep."
solved.reported: The doctor advised her to get more sleep.
solved.ar: نصحها الطبيب بالحصول على مزيد من النوم.

direct.en: Teacher: Where did you go yesterday, Adam?
direct.ar: المعلم: إلى أين ذهبت أمس يا آدم؟

direct.en: Adam: I went to the science museum.
Teacher: Did you enjoy the visit?
Teacher: What did you learn there?
Adam: I learned about planets and space.
Teacher: Can you show us your pictures?
direct.ar: المعلم: هل تستطيع أن تعرض لنا صورك؟

direct.en: Teacher: Please open your notebook and write three sentences about your visit. Don't make any noise while your classmates are working.
direct.ar: المعلم: من فضلك افتح دفترك واكتب ثلاث جمل عن زيارتك. لا تُحدث أي ضوضاء بينما يعمل زملاؤك.

reported.en: The teacher asked Adam where he had gone the previous day.
reported.ar: سأل المعلم آدم إلى أين ذهب في اليوم السابق.

reported.en: Adam replied that he had gone to the science museum.
reported.ar: أجاب آدم بأنه ذهب إلى متحف العلوم.

reported.en: The teacher asked him if he had enjoyed the visit.
reported.ar: سأله المعلم عما إذا كان قد استمتع بالزيارة.

reported.en: The teacher asked him what he had learned there.
Adam replied that he had learned about planets and space.
reported.ar: أجاب آدم بأنه تعلم عن الكواكب والفضاء.

reported.en: The teacher asked him if he could show them his pictures.
reported.ar: سأله المعلم عما إذا كان يستطيع أن يعرض عليهم صوره.

reported.en: Finally, the teacher asked him to open his notebook and write three sentences about his visit. The teacher also told the students not to make any noise while their classmates were working.
reported.ar: وفي النهاية، طلب المعلم منه أن يفتح دفتره ويكتب ثلاث جمل عن زيارته. كما طلب من الطلاب ألا يُحدثوا ضوضاء بينما يعمل زملاؤهم.

notes: Where did you go? → where he had gone.
Did you enjoy? → if he had enjoyed.
What did you learn? → what he had learned.
Can you show? → if he could show.
Please open → asked him to open.
Don't make → told them not to make.
dialogue.context: هذا الحوار يجمع بين الأسئلة والأوامر والنواهي في موقف واحد. يحافظ النقل أعلاه على نموذج المصدر: told the students، ويفترض مخاطبة الطلاب كمجموعة. لكن الحوار يخاطب آدم؛ إذا استمر النهي موجّهًا إليه وحده فالأدق: The teacher also told him not to make any noise while his classmates were working. أي طلب منه ألا يُحدث ضوضاء بينما يعمل زملاؤه. لا نستطيع الجزم بالمخاطَب من الصيغة وحدها. وسؤال Can you show قد ينقل سؤالًا عن الإمكانية كما في المصدر، أو طلبًا مهذبًا بحسب الموقف: The teacher asked him to show them his pictures.

reading.title: A School Visit
reading.context: ضمير he في سؤال التقاط الصور قد يلتبس بالمرشد أو الطالب. تفهم إجابة المصدر أن الطالب يستأذن لنفسه؛ يمكن إزالة اللبس بذكر the student صراحةً. يحافظ النص أعلاه على صياغة القطعة الأصلية.

paragraphs.en: Last Monday, a group of students visited a science center with their teacher.
paragraphs.ar: في يوم الاثنين الماضي، زارت مجموعة من الطلاب مركزًا للعلوم برفقة معلمهم.

paragraphs.en: When they arrived, the guide asked them where they were from. The students replied that they were from a local school.
paragraphs.ar: عندما وصلوا، سألهم المرشد من أين أتوا. فأجاب الطلاب بأنهم من مدرسة محلية.

paragraphs.en: The guide then asked whether they had visited the center before. Most of them said that they had not.
paragraphs.ar: ثم سألهم المرشد عما إذا كانوا قد زاروا المركز من قبل. وقال معظمهم إنهم لم يفعلوا ذلك.

paragraphs.en: The guide told the students to stay together and instructed them to follow the signs. He warned them not to touch the machines without permission.
paragraphs.ar: طلب المرشد من الطلاب أن يبقوا معًا، ووجّههم إلى اتباع اللافتات. كما حذّرهم من لمس الأجهزة دون إذن.

paragraphs.en: One student asked the guide if he could take photographs. The guide replied that he could take photographs in some areas.
paragraphs.ar: سأل أحد الطلاب المرشد عما إذا كان يستطيع التقاط الصور. فأجابه المرشد بأنه يستطيع التقاط الصور في بعض المناطق.

paragraphs.en: Later, the teacher asked the students what they had learned. One student explained that he had learned how robots worked.
paragraphs.ar: وفي وقت لاحق، سأل المعلم الطلاب عما تعلموه. وشرح أحد الطلاب أنه تعلم كيف تعمل الروبوتات.

paragraphs.en: At the end of the visit, the teacher advised everyone to read more about science at home.
paragraphs.ar: وفي نهاية الزيارة، نصح المعلم الجميع بقراءة المزيد عن العلوم في المنزل.

questions.a: They went to a science center.

questions.q: What did the guide ask them?
questions.a: He asked them where they were from and whether they had visited the center before.
questions.aar: سألهم من أين أتوا وعما إذا كانوا قد زاروا المركز من قبل.

questions.q: What did the guide tell the students to do?
questions.qar: ماذا طلب المرشد من الطلاب أن يفعلوا؟
questions.a: He told them to stay together and instructed them to follow the signs.
questions.aar: طلب منهم البقاء معًا ووجّههم إلى اتباع اللافتات.

questions.q: What did the guide warn them not to do?
questions.a: He warned them not to touch the machines without permission.
questions.aar: حذّرهم من لمس الأجهزة دون إذن.

questions.q: What did one student ask the guide?
questions.a: The student asked if he could take photographs.
questions.aar: سأل الطالب عما إذا كان يستطيع التقاط الصور.

questions.q: What did the teacher advise the students to do?
questions.a: He advised them to read more about science at home.
questions.aar: نصحهم بقراءة المزيد عن العلوم في المنزل.

writing.instruction: اكتب فقرة من 8 إلى 12 جملة عن موقف حدث في المدرسة، واستخدم فيها الكلام المنقول.
writing.title: A Day at School
writing.context: سؤال استخدام القاموس في نموذج المصدر قد يكون طلب إذن مهذبًا بحسب السياق، وقد يكون سؤالًا عن الإمكانية. لإظهار طلب فعل صريح يمكن إضافة: One student asked her to explain the question. أي طلب منها أحد الطلاب أن تشرح السؤال.

model.en: Yesterday, our teacher asked us if we were ready for the English test. She asked us what we had studied the previous day.
model.ar: أمس، سألتنا معلمتنا عما إذا كنا مستعدين لاختبار اللغة الإنجليزية. وسألتنا عما درسناه في اليوم السابق.

model.en: Then she told us to open our books and read the first passage. She warned us not to talk during the test.
model.ar: ثم طلبت منا أن نفتح كتبنا ونقرأ القطعة الأولى. وحذّرتنا من التحدث أثناء الاختبار.

model.en: One student asked her if he could use a dictionary. She told him to wait until she gave permission.
model.ar: سألها أحد الطلاب عما إذا كان يستطيع استخدام قاموس. وطلبت منه أن ينتظر حتى تعطيه الإذن.

model.en: After the test, she advised us to practise English every day. One student suggested studying together after school.
model.ar: بعد الاختبار، نصحتنا بممارسة الإنجليزية كل يوم. واقترح أحد الطلاب أن ندرس معًا بعد المدرسة.

model.en: It was a useful and interesting lesson.

speaking.instruction: تخيل أنك تتحدث مع صديقك عن زيارة قمت بها إلى متحف. أجب شفهيًا عن الأسئلة التالية، ثم حوّل إجاباتك إلى الكلام المنقول.

questions.en: What did the guide tell you to do?
questions.ar: ماذا طلب منك المرشد أن تفعل؟

pairs.reported: I told my friend that I had gone to a museum.
I told my friend that I had seen many interesting objects.

pairs.direct: The guide told me, "Don't touch the objects."
pairs.reported: I told my friend that the guide had warned me not to touch the objects.

summary.title: نقل أسئلة Yes/No
summary.reported: He asked if I was happy.

summary.title: نقل أسئلة WH
summary.note: نحتفظ بأداة السؤال؛ إن كانت هي الفاعل فلا نضيف فاعلًا آخر.

summary.title: نقل الأوامر
summary.reported: He told me to open the door.
summary.note: نذكر الشخص ثم الفعل الأساسي مع to.

summary.title: نقل النواهي
summary.reported: He told me not to run.
summary.note: تتحول صيغة النهي إلى not to.

summary.title: نقل الطلبات
summary.reported: He asked me to help him.
summary.note: نقل الطلب يختلف عن السؤال عن القدرة.

summary.title: نقل النصائح
summary.reported: She advised me to study harder.

summary.title: نقل التحذيرات
summary.reported: He warned me not to touch it.

summary.title: نقل الاقتراحات
summary.formula: suggested + verb-ing  /  suggested that + subject + should + verb
summary.note: أو suggested that مع الفاعل والفعل الأساسي.

summary.title: أهم الفروق التي يجب حفظها
summary.formula: if / whether · WH · subject + verb · told / asked / advised / warned · suggested + ing / that
summary.note: Yes/No: نستخدم if أو whether. WH: نحتفظ بالأداة. السؤال المنقول: ترتيب الجملة الخبرية لا ترتيب السؤال. الأمر: told + object + to؛ النهي: told + object + not to؛ الطلب: asked + object + to؛ النصيحة: advised + object + to؛ التحذير: warned + object + not to؛ الاقتراح: suggested + ing أو suggested that.

distinctions: Yes/No Question: نستخدم if أو whether.
Reported Question: نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية، لا ترتيب السؤال.
Negative Command: told + object + not to.
Suggestion: suggested + ing أو suggested that.

practices.title: تحويل أسئلة Yes/No
practices.instruction: حوّل الجمل التالية إلى الكلام المنقول.

items.prompt: He asked me, "Are you hungry?"
items.answer: He asked me if I was hungry.
items.why: Are → was. You → I.

items.prompt: She asked him, "Do you play football?"
items.answer: She asked him if he played football.
items.why: Do حُذفت. You → he. Play → played.

items.prompt: The teacher asked us, "Have you finished the task?"
items.answer: The teacher asked us if we had finished the task.
items.why: Have finished → had finished.

items.prompt: My father asked me, "Did you call your friend?"
items.answer: My father asked me if I had called my friend.
items.why: Did اختفت. Called → had called.

items.prompt: They asked her, "Can you speak French?"
items.answer: They asked her if she could speak French.
items.why: Can → could.

items.prompt: She asked me, "Will you visit us tomorrow?"
items.answer: She asked me whether I would visit them the following day.
accept: She asked me if I would visit them tomorrow.
She asked me whether I would visit them tomorrow.
items.why: Will → would. Tomorrow → the following day. Us → them بحسب سياق الكلام. يتغير tomorrow عند تغير يوم النقل، وقد يبقى عند ثبات المرجع.

practices.title: تحويل أسئلة WH
practices.instruction: حوّل الجمل، محتفظًا بأداة السؤال وبترتيب الجملة الخبرية.

items.prompt: He asked me, "Where do you work?"
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.
items.why: حذفنا do، ووضعنا الفاعل قبل الفعل.

items.prompt: She asked him, "Why are you crying?"
items.answer: She asked him why he was crying.
items.why: احتفظنا بـ Why، وحولنا Are إلى was.

items.prompt: The teacher asked us, "What did you write?"
items.answer: The teacher asked us what we had written.
items.why: Did write → had written.

items.prompt: My mother asked me, "When will you come home?"
items.answer: My mother asked me when I would come home.
items.why: Will → would.

items.prompt: He asked her, "How long have you lived here?"
items.answer: He asked her how long she had lived there.
accept: He asked her how long she had lived here.
items.why: Have lived → had lived. Here → there. يتغير here إلى there إذا تغير المكان المرجعي، وقد يبقى عند ثباته.

items.prompt: The man asked me, "Who broke the glass?"
items.answer: He asked me who had broken the glass.
accept: The man asked me who had broken the glass.
items.why: Who هي الفاعل، ولذلك لم نضف ضميرًا آخر بعدها. He تشير إلى الرجل في نموذج الإجابة.

practices.title: تحويل الأوامر والنواهي
practices.instruction: حوّل الجمل إلى الكلام المنقول، واختر الفعل بحسب معنى الموقف.

items.prompt: The teacher said to me, "Stand up."
items.answer: The teacher told me to stand up.
items.why: أمر مثبت: told + me + to + base verb.

items.prompt: My mother said to me, "Clean your room."
items.answer: My mother told me to clean my room.
items.why: الأمر يتبع told me to، وتتحول your إلى my بحسب المخاطَب.

items.prompt: The officer said to the driver, "Stop the car."
items.answer: The officer ordered the driver to stop the car.
accept: The officer told the driver to stop the car.
items.why: استخدم النموذج ordered للأمر الحازم؛ told ممكنة إن لم نقصد تأكيد الحزم.

items.prompt: The teacher said to the students, "Don't talk."
items.answer: The teacher told the students not to talk.
items.why: Don't → not to في النهي.

items.prompt: My father said to me, "Don't waste your money."
items.answer: My father told me not to waste my money.
items.why: told me not to مع تغيير your إلى my.

items.prompt: The guide said to us, "Don't touch the paintings."
items.answer: The guide warned us not to touch the paintings.
accept: The guide told us not to touch the paintings.
items.why: يفترض النموذج أن القصد تحذير من تصرف قد يسبب مشكلة؛ told ممكنة لأمر من دون تأكيد التحذير.

practices.postscript: استخدمنا ordered في الأمر الحازم، وwarned عندما كان الكلام تحذيرًا من تصرف قد يسبب مشكلة.

practices.title: الطلبات والنصائح والتحذيرات
practices.instruction: اختر الفعل الذي ينقل قصد المتحدث، ثم اكتب التحويل.

items.prompt: He said to me, "Could you carry this box?"
items.answer: He asked me to carry that box.
accept: He asked me to carry this box.
items.why: القصد طلب مهذب؛ this → that عند تغير مرجع الإشارة.
items.ar: طلب مني أن أحمل ذلك الصندوق.

items.prompt: She said to him, "Please wait here."
items.answer: She asked him to wait there.
accept: She asked him to wait here.
items.why: طلب مهذب باستخدام asked + object + to؛ يتغير here إذا تغير المكان.

items.prompt: The doctor said to me, "Drink more water."
items.answer: The doctor advised me to drink more water.
items.why: نصيحة: advised + me + to.
items.ar: نصحني الطبيب بشرب المزيد من الماء.

items.prompt: The teacher said to us, "Don't use your phones during the lesson."
items.answer: The teacher told us not to use our phones during the lesson.
items.why: نهي: told us not to، وyour → our.
items.ar: طلب منا المعلم ألا نستخدم هواتفنا أثناء الدرس.

items.prompt: My friend said, "Let's play chess."
items.answer: My friend suggested playing chess.
accept: My friend suggested that we should play chess.
My friend suggested that we play chess.
items.why: اقتراح: suggested + verb-ing أو suggested that + subject + (should) + base verb.

items.prompt: The coach said to the players, "You should practise every day."
items.answer: The coach advised the players to practise every day.
items.why: نقل النصيحة باستخدام advised + object + to.

practices.title: اختر الإجابة الصحيحة
practices.instruction: اختر الإجابة، ثم تحقّق واقرأ السبب.

items.prompt: He asked me where _____.
items.answer: B. I lived
items.why: لأن السؤال المنقول يستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية.

items.prompt: She asked if I _____ ready.
items.answer: A. was
accept: B. am
items.why: لأننا نطبق الرجوع الزمني من am إلى was. ويمكن إبقاء am إذا ظلت الجاهزية قائمة ولم نستخدم الرجوع الزمني.

items.prompt: The teacher told us _____ quiet.
items.answer: B. to be
items.why: لأن تركيب الأمر المنقول هو told + object + to + verb.

items.prompt: He warned me _____ touch the wire.
items.answer: C. not to
accept: B. to not
items.why: لأن النهي المنقول يستخدم not to + infinitive. وصيغة to not صحيحة أيضًا في الإنجليزية القياسية، وإن كان not to أكثر شيوعًا هنا.

items.prompt: She asked me _____ I liked tea.
items.answer: B. if
items.why: لأن السؤال من نوع Yes/No.

items.prompt: My friend suggested _____ a film.
items.answer: B. watching
items.why: لأن suggest يأتي بعده غالبًا فعل ينتهي بـ ing.

items.prompt: He asked her what she _____.
items.answer: A. was doing
items.why: لأن ترتيب السؤال المنقول هو الفاعل ثم الفعل.

items.prompt: The doctor advised him _____ smoking.
items.answer: C. to stop
items.why: لأن advised + object + to + infinitive.

practices.title: اكتشف الخطأ وصححه
practices.instruction: في كل جملة خطأ واحد. اكتب الجملة الصحيحة.

items.prompt: He asked me where did I work.
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.
items.why: الخطأ did I work؛ الصحيح I worked.

items.prompt: She asked if was I happy.
items.answer: She asked if I was happy.
items.why: الخطأ was I؛ الصحيح I was.

items.prompt: My father told me don't be late.
items.answer: My father told me not to be late.
items.why: الخطأ don't be؛ الصحيح not to be.

items.prompt: The teacher asked us where were we going.
items.answer: The teacher asked us where we were going.
items.why: الخطأ were we؛ الصحيح we were.

items.prompt: She suggested me to study harder.
items.answer: She suggested studying harder.
accept: She suggested that I should study harder.
She suggested that I study harder.
items.why: الخطأ suggested me to study؛ استخدم suggested + ing أو suggested that + subject + (should) + base verb.

items.prompt: He asked me if did I know the answer.
items.answer: He asked me if I knew the answer.
items.why: الخطأ if did I know؛ الصحيح if I knew.

items.prompt: The doctor advised her taking more rest.
items.answer: The doctor advised her to get more rest.
accept: The doctor advised her to take more rest.
items.why: الخطأ: advised her taking. الصحيح: advised her to get. ويصح أيضًا إصلاح التركيب بأقل تغيير: advised her to take.

items.prompt: The guard warned us don't enter the building.
items.answer: The guard warned us not to enter the building.
items.why: الخطأ warned us don't enter؛ الصحيح warned us not to enter.

practices.title: ترجم إلى الإنجليزية
practices.instruction: ترجم إلى الإنجليزية. قد تكون هناك ترجمات صحيحة أخرى بحسب السياق.

items.prompt: سألني أين أعيش.
items.answer: He asked me where I lived.
items.why: نحافظ على where ونضع الفاعل قبل الفعل.

items.prompt: سألتني عما إذا كنت أستطيع السباحة.
items.answer: She asked me if I could swim.
items.why: سؤال نعم أو لا: if ثم I could.

items.prompt: أخبرني المعلم أن أفتح الكتاب.
items.answer: The teacher told me to open the book.
items.why: told + me + to + open.

items.prompt: طلبت مني أمي ألا أتأخر.
items.answer: My mother asked me not to be late.
items.why: طلب منفي: asked me not to.

items.prompt: سأل المعلم الطلاب ماذا تعلموا.
items.answer: The teacher asked the students what they had learned.
items.why: what ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل في الزمن المناسب.

items.prompt: نصحني الطبيب أن أشرب المزيد من الماء.
items.answer: The doctor advised me to drink more water.
items.why: النصيحة: advised me to.

items.prompt: حذّرنا المرشد من الاقتراب من النهر.
items.answer: The guide warned us not to go near the river.
items.why: التحذير المنفي: warned us not to.

items.prompt: اقترح صديقي أن نلعب كرة القدم.
items.answer: My friend suggested playing football.
accept: My friend suggested that we should play football.
My friend suggested that we play football.
items.why: suggested + ing أو suggested that we (should) play.

practices.title: حوّل الفقرة كاملة
practices.instruction: حوّل جميع الجمل السابقة إلى الكلام المنقول، في فقرة واحدة.
practices.paragraph: The teacher said to the students: "Are you ready for the test? Have you studied all the lessons? What did you find difficult? Please open your notebooks. Write your answers carefully. Don't talk to your friends. If you have a question, ask me."
checklist: Are you ready for the test?
Have you studied all the lessons?
If you have a question, ask me.

items.prompt: The teacher said to the students: "Are you ready for the test? Have you studied all the lessons? What did you find difficult? Please open your notebooks. Write your answers carefully. Don't talk to your friends. If you have a question, ask me."
items.answer: The teacher asked the students if they were ready for the test. He also asked them whether they had studied all the lessons. Then he asked them what they had found difficult. He asked them to open their notebooks and told them to write their answers carefully. He told them not to talk to their friends. Finally, he told them to ask him if they had a question.
items.ar: سأل المعلم الطلاب عما إذا كانوا مستعدين للاختبار. وسألهم أيضًا عما إذا كانوا قد درسوا جميع الدروس. ثم سألهم عما وجدوه صعبًا. وطلب منهم فتح دفاترهم، وطلب منهم كتابة إجاباتهم بعناية. كما طلب منهم ألا يتحدثوا مع أصدقائهم. وأخيرًا، طلب منهم أن يسألوه إذا كان لديهم سؤال.
items.why: نموذج المصدر يستخدم he للمعلم؛ يتحدد الضمير بالسياق. وif في التعليمات الأخيرة شرطية، وليست رابط سؤال Yes/No. قد تصح صياغات أخرى تحفظ المعنى.

model.en: The teacher asked the students if they were ready for the test.
model.ar: سأل المعلم الطلاب عما إذا كانوا مستعدين للاختبار.

model.en: He also asked them whether they had studied all the lessons.
model.ar: وسألهم أيضًا عما إذا كانوا قد درسوا جميع الدروس.

model.en: Then he asked them what they had found difficult.
He asked them to open their notebooks and told them to write their answers carefully.
model.ar: وطلب منهم فتح دفاترهم، وطلب منهم كتابة إجاباتهم بعناية.

model.en: He told them not to talk to their friends.
model.ar: كما طلب منهم ألا يتحدثوا مع أصدقائهم.

model.en: Finally, he told them to ask him if they had a question.
model.ar: وأخيرًا، طلب منهم أن يسألوه إذا كان لديهم سؤال.

original.prompt: He asked me, "Are you tired?"
original.answer: He asked me if I was tired.
original.why: Are → was، وyou → I.

original.prompt: She asked him, "Do you like reading?"
original.answer: She asked him if he liked reading.
original.why: حذفنا Do، وغيّرنا like إلى liked.

original.prompt: The teacher asked us, "Have you completed the project?"
original.answer: The teacher asked us if we had completed the project.
original.why: Have completed → had completed.

original.prompt: My mother asked me, "Will you come home early?"
original.answer: My mother asked me whether I would come home early.
original.why: Will → would.

original.prompt: He asked her, "Can you drive?"
original.answer: He asked her if she could drive.
original.why: Can → could.

original.prompt: She asked me, "Where do you study?"
original.answer: She asked me where I studied.
original.why: حافظنا على Where، وحذفنا do.

original.prompt: He asked her, "Why are you upset?"
original.answer: He asked her why she was upset.
original.why: حافظنا على Why، وغيّرنا ترتيب السؤال.

original.prompt: The teacher asked him, "What did you write?"
original.answer: The teacher asked him what he had written.
original.why: Did write → had written.

original.prompt: My father asked me, "When will you travel?"
original.answer: My father asked me when I would travel.
original.why: Will → would.

original.prompt: She asked, "Who opened the door?"
original.answer: She asked who had opened the door.
original.why: Who هي الفاعل، لذلك لم نضف فاعلًا آخر.

original.prompt: The teacher said to us, "Sit down."
original.answer: The teacher told us to sit down.
original.why: أمر مثبت: told + object + to + verb.

original.prompt: My father said to me, "Don't waste your time."
original.answer: My father told me not to waste my time.
original.why: نهي: told + object + not to + verb.

original.prompt: The officer said to the driver, "Stop immediately."
original.answer: The officer ordered the driver to stop immediately.
accept: The officer told the driver to stop immediately.
original.why: استخدمنا ordered لأن الأمر حازم. وتصح told أيضًا عندما لا يُبرز الناقل الحزم.

original.prompt: The guide said to us, "Don't touch the equipment."
original.answer: The guide warned us not to touch the equipment.
accept: The guide told us not to touch the equipment.
original.why: استخدمنا warned لأنه تحذير. وتصح told أيضًا إن كان مجرد نهي بحسب السياق.

original.prompt: The teacher said to the students, "Write your names."
original.answer: The teacher told the students to write their names.
original.why: أمر مثبت باستخدام told + object + to.

original.prompt: He said to me, "Could you help me?"
original.answer: He asked me to help him.
original.why: طلب مهذب، لذلك استخدمنا asked + object + to. أما if I could help فتنقل السؤال عن الإمكانية بحسب السياق.

original.prompt: The doctor said to him, "Exercise regularly."
original.answer: The doctor advised him to exercise regularly.
original.why: نصيحة باستخدام advised.

original.prompt: She said, "Let's go shopping."
original.answer: She suggested going shopping.
accept: She suggested that we should go shopping.
She suggested that we go shopping.
original.why: اقتراح باستخدام suggested + ing.

original.prompt: My mother said to me, "Please don't stay up late."
original.answer: My mother asked me not to stay up late.
original.why: طلب منفي باستخدام asked + object + not to.

original.prompt: The teacher said to us, "You should revise your lessons."
original.answer: The teacher advised us to revise our lessons.
original.why: نصيحة باستخدام advised.

original.prompt: He asked me where _____.
original.answer: B. I was going
original.why: لأن السؤال المنقول لا يستخدم ترتيب السؤال المباشر.

original.prompt: She asked whether I _____ finished.
original.answer: B. had
accept: A. have
original.why: لأن Present Perfect أصبح Past Perfect. هذا نموذج للرجوع الزمني؛ ويمكن إبقاء have إذا ظلت النتيجة حاضرة ولم نستخدم الرجوع الزمني.

original.prompt: The teacher told us _____ quiet.
original.answer: A. to be
original.why: لأن told + object + to + infinitive.

original.prompt: He warned me _____ touch the machine.
original.answer: B. not to
accept: C. to not
original.why: لأن warned + object + not to + infinitive. وصيغة to not صحيحة أيضًا في الإنجليزية القياسية، وإن كان not to أكثر شيوعًا هنا.

original.prompt: She suggested _____ at home.
original.answer: C. studying
original.why: لأن suggest يأتي بعده غالبًا فعل ينتهي بـ ing.
